verifier-balanced.workload: Issue-completion and provider-comparison judgments where false PASS is the highest-cost error.

provisional_stage.note: A paired screen and capped API confirmation may support a reversible, human-approved provisional selection. These are observed-case safeguards, not population confidence claims. Monitor live outcomes and roll back on a false PASS or material regression.

approval_stage.retired_note: Owner decision 2026-10-30: automatic approval is retired. This stage never approved a model, and the 2026-10-22 analysis (docs/ops/VERIFIER_STANDARDS_ANALYSIS.md) showed zero-error bounds approve only a perfect judge. A verifier-balanced selection now changes only by the owner's decision after a corpus trial (docs/ops/VERIFIER_SHADOW.md, 'Trialling a new candidate'), recorded in config/model_registry.json as on 2026-10-30. The fields below stay in force as corpus-generation settings and as reported measurements, never as a blocker; tools/prepare_model_promotion.py still prepares rollbacks on a gate breach but no longer prepares promotions. Set status to active to restore automatic approval.
approval_stage.minimum_cases_per_category_overrides_not: These three categories cannot be labelled from realized downstream outcomes, so tools/harvest_verifier_corpus.py never produces them and they remain owner-sourced. Holding them to the machine-harvestable floor of 10 made `approved` unreachable without ~22 hand-labelled cases, so for them the floor asserts REPRESENTATION (at least one adjudicated example of the failure mode) rather than statistical power. The statistical gates (false-pass/false-fail/schema-error Wilson bounds, paired non-inferiority) still run over the whole corpus, and minimum_adjudicated_cases=75 still applies. Raise these toward 10 as owner-labelled cases accumulate. See #2819. Update 2026-10-18: missing-acceptance-criterion is raised to 10 because controlled-mutation cases supply it mechanically; follow-up-required is lowered from 10 to 3 because resolved verifier follow-ups are too rare to reach 10 (3 exist, none new in 8 weekly harvests), so it asserts representation.

stable_merge_pass.note: Owner decision 2026-10-18. PASS cases that join a verifier decision only begin to appear about a month after the decision marker was introduced (about 2026-10-15), so the false-fail floor could not be met. A captured merged PR may be labelled PASS by realized outcome alone: merged at least minimum_age_days ago, not reverted, no verifier follow-up label, and an input the production prompt calls sufficient. These cases carry provenance stable-merge. The label is weaker (no verifier run is joined, and a repair without a follow-up label is invisible); a mislabelled PASS counts as a false FAIL, so the error is conservative. Set enabled to false to stop using them.

approval_stage.bounds_note: Owner direction 2026-10-18: make approval practically achievable. At 95% confidence a zero-error run needs 73 cases for a 0.05 bound, 35 for 0.10, 22 for 0.15 and 16 for 0.20. The old 0.05 / 0.10 bounds needed 73 NON_PASS and 35 PASS evaluable cases; the corpus can supply 41 and 16 (captured inputs the production prompt calls sufficient), so the bounds are now 0.10 false PASS (35 NON_PASS) and 0.20 false FAIL (16 PASS). A bound is a statement about what the sample cannot rule out; approval remains a reversible, human-approved provisional selection with rollback on any false PASS and live monitoring, so these are screening-grade guarantees, not population claims. A false FAIL costs rework, a false PASS costs safety, which is why the false-PASS bound stays tighter. Tighten the bounds again as evaluable cases accumulate.

controlled_mutation.note: Owner decision 2026-10-18. Realized outcomes supply NON_PASS cases at about 8% of harvested cases (4 of 51), while the false-PASS gate needs 73 NON_PASS at zero errors, so the gate was unreachable. Controlled-mutation cases (provenance controlled-mutation: a real PASS PR whose evidence for one acceptance criterion is removed, objectively NON_PASS) count toward the NON_PASS total and the false-PASS bound, are reported separately from real cases, and may not replace real signal: at least minimum_real_non_pass_cases real NON_PASS cases must exist. Set counts_toward_false_pass_bound to false to return to real-outcome evidence only.

corpus_growth.note: Move 2 of #2819. High-confidence realized-outcome cases (stable merges, reverts, resolved verifier follow-ups) auto-grow the frozen corpus; ambiguous cases stage FYI-only and auto-expire. The stale-verifier-claim / review-thread-debt / missing-acceptance-criterion categories are NOT machine-labelable and remain owner-sourced.
